_note: Quayholt Insurance office kit (WAVE2_BUILD.md D12, P-KQ). Tiles are px/32 on the 10x10 room_aw_quayholt map. The map draws no source for a non-work need, so the kit declares a water_cooler with an explicit position, using the preloaded water_cooler1.png (24x47); rooms.js creates the sprite by the fallback (findMatchFor null, createSpriteAtRandomPosition, applyScenarioObjectPosition) and moves it to position. The cooler has no collision body (the engine gives static bodies only to tables and wheeled chairs, rooms.js ~2805-2834); click-to-move routes round it (path-avoid.js water_cooler pattern) as round Tarrowby's vending machine, checked in gate D proof 11. position (8.2,5.6) is the sprite top-left corner; free floor in room_aw_quayholt is x1-9, y2-9, and column 8 rows 5-7 (below the wall-hung extinguisher) is clear (kiosk covers cols 7-8 rows 3-4, the desk row 8 with its chair column 7). useFrom is from the sprite centre. Staff homes are drawn desk chairs: Darren and Niamh at the left desk (chairs ~2.9 and 4.1, y6.8), Anjali at the right desk (chair ~7.4, y8.3); confirmed/adjusted live in gate D. Every colleague carries one thirst need so they leave home, drink at the cooler and sit again. Pool kit_quayholt, capacity-2, three lines; each of Darren, Niamh and Anjali two chatterLines. Voices from VOICE_CAST.md.

Darren speaks one line aloud when the defend set finishes (kit_defend_done -> true); delayMs lets the delayed-mapping runner wait for the kiosk to close, so it lands after the sort. targetKnot (no literal bark) makes the engine speak ca05_react's first line via TTS, so the line lives in the ambient ink and branches there on kit_key_caught, true on every path. Twin only; the full ca05 shell uses ca05_signin_prompt. No globals/objects/timers/mappings: the twin is defend-only (tier S).

ca05_signin_prompt._note: ca05 colleague request (WAVE5_BUILD.md s6). Darren, the service desk lead, has typed his password into a lookalike voicemail page, which now shows a number to enter in the approval prompt on his phone. The prompt is genuine and the number matches, so the address is the only tell. Wrong or no answer: Anjali says a sign-in link has gone from Darren's account to the whole claims team (row 8), and the PC shows his inbox as normal (moved). Right answer (stop): done after 4 s. Darren is frozen on needs and never suspended; Anjali is suspended and walked to her post (7.4, 8.3), her kit needsHome. No mapping reads her arrival.

ca10_paste_check._note: ca10 colleague request (WAVE6_BUILD.md s4). Darren, the service desk lead, has opened the Fernside supplier portal from his bookmarks and it shows a 'Verify you are human' box that wants Windows and R, a paste and Enter. The line would fetch a stealer that copies the browser's saved passwords and signed-in sessions. Wrong or no answer: Anjali says Darren's account is being used from somewhere nobody has seen (row 8), and the PC shows nothing wrong (moved). Right answer (close): done after 4 s. Darren is frozen on needs and never suspended; Anjali is suspended and walked to her post (7.4, 8.3), her kit needsHome. No mapping reads her arrival.
